test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete in 2 days as much of a task as B can complete in 3 days and B can complete in 4 days as much of the task as C can complete in 5 days. In what times will A, B and C together complete the task if A alone can complete it in 22 days?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete in 2 days as much of a task as B can complete in 3 days.

B can complete in 4 days as much of the task as C can complete in 5 days.

A alone can complete the task in 22 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work rate of A, B, and C combined = Work rate of A + Work rate of B + Work rate of C

Time to complete the task = 1 / Work rate of A, B, and C combined

**Calculation:**

Work rate of A = 1/22

Let the task be x units.

In 2 days, A completes (2/22) × x = (1/11) × x units.

In 3 days, B completes (3/33) × x = (1/11) × x units.

⇒ B's work rate = (1/33)

In 4 days, B completes (4/33) × x units.

In 5 days, C completes (5/55) × x = (1/11) × x units.

⇒ C's work rate = (1/55)

Combined work rate of A, B, and C = (1/22) + (1/33) + (1/55)

⇒ Combined work rate = (165 + 110 + 66) / (22 × 33 × 55)

⇒ Combined work rate = 341 / (22 × 33 × 55)

⇒ Combined work rate = 1 / 10

Time to complete the task = 1 / (1/10)

Time to complete the task = 10 days

**The correct answer is option 2.**
